items.source: Compared to IntroductionInfo, this interface allows an advice to implement a range of interfaces that is not necessarily known in advance. Thus an IntroductionAdvisor can be used to specify which interfaces will be exposed in an advised object.
items.translation: 与IntroductionInfo相比，此接口允许 advice 实现一系列不一定预先知道的接口。因此，可以使用IntroductionAdvisor来指定要在被建议对象中暴露的哪些接口。

items.source: Introductions are often mixins, enabling the building of composite objects that can achieve many of the goals of multiple inheritance in Java.
items.translation: 简介通常是mixins，使得能够构建复合对象，从而实现 Java 中多重继承的许多目标。

items.source: Does this introduction advice implement the given interface?
items.translation: 这段介绍是否建议实现了给定的接口？

items.source: whether the advice implements the specified interface
items.translation: 该建议是否实现了指定的接口
